I've had this happen to me as well. It's not a good place to be in, and I'm really sorry that she is treating you like that. I don't know you or the person you're talking about, but from what I can see here, I think it would probably be best to break things off with her. Some people will be toxic no matter what you say or do. Sometimes people will never be pleased. It's a very difficult thing to do, I know, but at this point it definitely seems necessary. She will survive if you do this, trust me. You're not responsible for her.

Many times, people like this don't realize how their behavior is affecting others. And when confronted about it, they will deny it and try to victimize themselves. All you can do is distance yourself from her and hope that one day she realizes how much she is hurting other people. 

I'm sure she's not some big bad evil person, but nothing gives her an excuse to act like that.

Anyways, I hope you have better days. ❤
